# GOSSADIR keys only a compile that writes an SSA dump into it.
# The dependencies keep their keys and come from the cache.

go build -o $WORK/plain.exe .

mkdir $WORK/ssa
env GOSSADIR=$WORK/ssa
go build -x -o $WORK/dump.exe -gcflags=-d=ssa/genssa/dump=main .
stderr 'compile .* -p main '
! stderr 'compile .* -p fmt '
exists $WORK/ssa/main_01__genssa.dump

# A new GOSSADIR compiles the package that dumps again, so the dump appears.
mkdir $WORK/ssa2
env GOSSADIR=$WORK/ssa2
go build -o $WORK/dump2.exe -gcflags=-d=ssa/genssa/dump=main .
exists $WORK/ssa2/main_01__genssa.dump

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
